findings: Stating the estimand moved the median relative error from 25.0% to 2.5% against the basis it now targets.
The upward bias is gone. v1 overshot on all three routes; v1.1 undershoots slightly on two and is exact on the third.

Bangkok to Phuket is the largest remaining gap at 16.7% low. It is also the route where the aggregator listed the widest spread between cheapest and representative, so it is the one most sensitive to the estimand wording.
One route's improvement is overstated: its v1 run had fallen back to the non-search path, so both the estimand and the grounding changed at once. The other two are clean.
Three routes, one run each, one model. Directional. A tolerance still should not be set from this.
